title: AI models
lede: Pick the model for each task and test it before it goes live.

choose.d: Search the OpenRouter list. The system registers the model in LiteLLM for you.

test.d: 20 cases for that task, about 3 minutes, compared with the model in use.

decide.d: If it passes, it is used at once. If the score drops by more than 2, you type to confirm.

tabs.label: Sections of the AI models page

load.failed: Could not load the AI model settings.

note.none: No thinking before answering. Fastest and cheapest, good for reading or extracting data.
note.minimal: Very little thinking. Fast, good for tasks with a clear pattern.
note.low: Short thinking. A balance of speed, quality and price.
note.medium: More careful thinking. Slower and costlier.
note.high: The most careful thinking. Slowest and costliest, for when quality matters more than time.

evaluate_job.name: Job evaluation
evaluate_job.desc: Scores how well a CV fits a job.

draft_documents.name: Document drafts
draft_documents.desc: Drafts cover letters and supporting documents.

extract_experience.name: Experience from CV
extract_experience.desc: Reads a CV and splits it into single facts.

tailor_cv.name: CV tailoring
tailor_cv.desc: Adapts a CV to a job, using only known facts.

apply_prepare.name: Application prep
apply_prepare.desc: Answers the questions of each job application.

interview_generate.name: Interview practice
interview_generate.desc: Writes the questions for a practice interview.

tasks.title: Which task uses which model
tasks.sub: The score comes from the latest test of that pair. Cost is the average per call in that test.
tasks.useOne: Use one model for every task
tasks.manualTip: This model uses a price an admin typed in, so the cost is an estimate.
tasks.emptyHint: The tasks of the app will be listed here once the service reports them.

library.title: Registered models
library.sub: Prices are per 1 million tokens and are used to work out the cost of every request. OpenRouter prices refresh once a day. Prices typed by hand are never overwritten.
library.sameAsInputTip: No cache price was entered, so the input price is used.
library.official: OpenRouter now has an official price for {{model}} (input {{in}} · output {{out}}). It still uses a price typed by hand.
library.emptyHint: Models you add or use for a task will be listed here with their prices.

history.title: Every test
history.emptyHint: Every test you run from a task's Change button will be kept here.

change.title: Change model: {{task}}
change.titleAll: Use one model for every task
change.searchHint: Type a name. Models already registered are listed first.
change.willRegister: Will be registered in LiteLLM for you
change.searchFailed: Could not reach the model list. Try again in a minute.
change.more: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Type more to narrow it down.
change.noTestNote: This task has no test set. You will confirm by typing a phrase.
change.queued: Waiting for the test to start
change.closeNote: You can close this window. The test keeps running and the result appears in Test history.
change.testFailed: The test could not finish. Pick the model again or try another one.
change.verdictGreenNoBase: Passed with a quality score of {{value}}.
change.verdictRedDrop: Quality fell by {{value}}, more than the 2 points allowed.
change.verdictRedErrors: The test had errors or cut-off answers.
change.verdictNa: This pair cannot be checked against a baseline.
change.verdictNaNoSet: This task has no test set, so nothing was tested.
change.greenSub: You can use it for {{task}} now.
change.redSub: You can still use it if you type the phrase below, but users may get less accurate results.
change.naSub: To use it anyway, type the phrase below.
change.doneTitle: Changed. New runs use it at once.
change.doneBody: {{task}} now uses {{model}} / {{effort}}. The change is in the audit log. Runs already in progress keep the old model until they finish.
change.allIntro: Choose the pair, then test it on each task. Each task is tested and applied on its own.

price.warnTitle: No price found for this model
price.warnBody: Neither OpenRouter nor LiteLLM lists a price. Costs will use the price you enter, so check it on the provider's price page first.
price.free: This model is really free (required when you enter 0)
price.needFree: A price of 0 needs the free box ticked.

add.title: Add model from OpenRouter
add.hint: Type part of a model name to search.
add.note: A model you add goes into the library. No task uses it until it passes a test and you choose to use it.

error.benchmark_required: This pair has no passing test. Run the test first, or type the phrase to confirm.
error.benchmark_busy: Another test is still running. Wait for it to finish, then start this one.
error.price_invalid: Check the prices: they must be numbers of 0 or more, and 0 needs the free box ticked.
error.model_invalid: The gateway does not accept this model name. Pick one from the search results.
error.service_unavailable: OpenRouter or the gateway could not be reached. Try again in a minute.
error.gateway_unconfigured: The gateway is not set up on the server, so models cannot be added.
error.official_price_unavailable: There is no official price for this model any more.
error.not_found: That item no longer exists. Reload the page.
error.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this.
